modern: Man, you have been a citizen in this great state, the world; what difference does it make to you whether it was for five years or three? For what is in keeping with the laws is just for all. Where, then, is the hardship, if it is no tyrant, nor yet an unjust judge, who sends you away from the state, but nature, who brought you into it? It is the same as if a praetor who has hired an actor dismisses him from the stage.—“But I have not finished the five acts, only three of them.”—You are right, but in life three acts are the whole drama; for what makes a complete drama is decided by the one who was once the cause of its making, and now of its undoing: but you are the cause of neither. Depart, then, content, for the one who releases you is content too.
original: Man, thou hast been a citizen in this great state [the world]; what difference does it make to thee whether for five years [or three]? for that which is conformable to the laws is just for all. Where is the hardship then, if no tyrant nor yet an unjust judge sends thee away from the state, but nature, who brought thee into it? the same as if a praetor who has employed an actor dismisses him from the stage.—“But I have not finished the five acts, but only three of them.”—Thou sayest well, but in life the three acts are the whole drama; for what shall be a complete drama is determined by him who was once the cause of its composition, and now of its dissolution: but thou art the cause of neither. Depart then satisfied, for he also who releases thee is satisfied.
